subject.title: refactor(whatsapp): centralize inbound turn admission and history finalization

question: Should `mapChannelIngressDecisionToTurnAdmission` become a supported experimental export of `plugin-sdk/channel-ingress-runtime`, rather than remain a WhatsApp-local adapter?
rationale: The branch is mechanically coherent, but choosing a public SDK seam determines the contract future channel plugins may adopt and cannot be resolved safely by automated review alone.

options.title: Accept the SDK seam
options.body: Approve the mapper as the canonical experimental ingress-to-turn-admission bridge and retain the documented redaction boundary.

options.title: Keep it owner-local
options.body: Request a revision that keeps the mapper inside WhatsApp until maintainers define a cross-channel SDK contract for prepared turn admission.

recommendation.title: Accept the SDK seam
recommendation.body: Approve the mapper as the canonical experimental ingress-to-turn-admission bridge and retain the documented redaction boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They were directly named in the active PR discussion and are the only concrete routing contact supplied for this API-boundary decision.
